skills.name: Godot Asset Library and Asset Store lifecycle
skills.skill: DISCOVER -> INSPECT -> LICENSE -> COMPATIBILITY -> DEPENDENCIES -> SANDBOX -> INSTALL -> IMPORT -> ENABLE -> TEST -> VISUAL_QA -> RUNTIME_QA -> EXPORT_QA -> RECORD -> PROMOTE
skills.verification: Use Godot 4.7 documentation, live store metadata, source repository, package inspection and runtime smoke tests.

skills.name: Asset package safety
skills.skill: Inspect archive structure, addons/plugin.cfg, project files, scripts, native binaries, licenses and dependencies before production installation.
skills.verification: Sandbox installation followed by logs, dependency checks and rollback test.

skills.name: Asset compatibility
skills.skill: Check Godot version, API compatibility, dependencies, renderer assumptions, native binaries and platform constraints before integration.
skills.verification: Open/import/run/export smoke tests on target Godot version.

skills.name: Visual evidence
skills.skill: Separate OBSERVED, INFERRED and UNKNOWN; use screenshots as evidence and follow visual observations with live Godot property/node inspection.
skills.verification: Before/after screenshot plus live node/property verification.

skills.name: Video workflow extraction
skills.skill: Use video and audio evidence to reconstruct Godot workflows, timestamps, tool actions, expected results, pitfalls and verification procedures.
skills.verification: Cross-check important claims against Godot documentation or live engine behavior.

skills.name: Microbrain execution boundary
skills.skill: Use the local micro-brain for small validated tool actions; escalate complex, multimodal or uncertain tasks to the external reasoning model.
skills.verification: JSON validation, tool catalog validation, escalation tests and runtime smoke tests.
